title: Declined payment shows an error and permits retry
milestone: First online launch of the Everyday Notebook
downstreamDependency: Noel needs Aryan's checkout to display the PAYMENT_DECLINED response and allow retry before completing commerce integration. Kiran's launch sign-off depends on that integrated checkout being ready.
acceptanceCriteria: A declined POST /checkout displays Payment declined. Please try again.
The user can retry and issue another POST /checkout.
handoffRule: Deliver only a completed passed result for the submitted revision; failed, unverified, or error results do not authorize delivery.
scopeNote: This is display metadata, not a submission API payload. Mobile layout, success payments, and duplicate-order prevention are outside this verification requirement.
